# Lab Validation Checklist

- [ ] Fresh environment works
- [ ] Imports succeed
- [ ] Dependency versions are reasonable
- [ ] Dataset source/path works
- [ ] Cells/steps run in order
- [ ] Variables are defined before use
- [ ] Tensor/array shapes are correct
- [ ] Runtime fits the allotted time
- [ ] CPU fallback exists when practical
- [ ] Expected output or sanity range is documented
- [ ] Randomness does not make the activity misleading
- [ ] Deliberate bugs are clearly separated from accidental bugs
- [ ] Solution path is known
- [ ] Optional steps are labeled
- [ ] Cleanup/reset instructions exist if needed
